lines.text: If I'd run for that key... I'd be *dead.*
lines.style: Young man, breathless and shaken, speaking fast to the viewer, the last word hard and flat.

lines.text: You told me to *stay.* So I hit a button.
lines.style: Young man, urgent, panicking but grateful, talking straight to the viewer, quick.

lines.text: The doors started closing. Then *fingers* came through.
lines.style: Young man, rising terror, the word fingers full of disgust and fear.

lines.text: And through the gap, it patted her *head.*
lines.style: Young man, stunned whisper, slowly realizing something awful, the last word chilling.

lines.text: That's one light, Theo. You have *two* left.
lines.style: Calm, polite, unsettling announcer voice over an old intercom, smiling too much, soft and slow.
Young man, barely a whisper, frozen with fear.

lines.text: Sixty-four. I'd seen that floor... in the *drawings.*
lines.style: Young man, dread creeping in, slow and quiet, the last word falling.
Young man, hushed and wary, a chill on the last word.
Young man, tense whisper, careful, listening.

lines.text: I pulled back the sheet... and it was *me.*
lines.style: Young man, slow whisper, horror breaking on the last word, voice cracking.
Young man, reading aloud in a shaking whisper, each word slow.
Young man, terrified, a sharp breath, the last word a gasp.

lines.text: Ten seconds. Wake him up... or pull the *plug?*
lines.style: Young man, panicking, fast and desperate, torn between two choices.

lines.text: Comment *A* or *B.* You decide what I do.
lines.style: Young man, urgent and direct, speaking straight to the viewer, pleading but steady.
